backend/main.mo: Actor manages user profiles with access control, providing create and update functions and storing profiles in a map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing routing, auth, and fallback UI improvements with related files and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for various frontend pages and routing components in the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light and dark modes with EVRVEST color system.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint loading the React app and mounting it to the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App router setup with TanStack Router, query client, theme provider, route definitions, and loading/error boundaries.
frontend/src/components/builder/Exercise: Dialog component for searching and selecting exercises from a mock list.
frontend/src/components/exercises/Exerci: Clickable card displaying exercise metadata such as sport, difficulty, and coaching cue.
frontend/src/components/exercises/LoadRe: Card that calculates and displays dynamic load recommendations with slider adjustment and zone feedback.
frontend/src/components/exercises/MediaP: UI placeholder component for missing exercise images or videos.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout wrapper with header, content container, and bottom tab navigation.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header component with logo/back button and logout handling using Internet Identity and React Router.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Bottom navigation bar rendering five route tabs with active state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/refresh/PullToRe: Custom pull-to-refresh wrapper tracking touch gestures and triggering async refresh.
frontend/src/components/routing/AppLoadi: Full‑screen loading UI with spinner and loading text.
frontend/src/components/routing/RouteErr: Error fallback screen displaying error details and a reload button.
frontend/src/components/subscription/Pro: Gatekeeper component blocking content unless user has Pro subscription, with upgrade prompt.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated backend actor and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Admin hooks for fetching all users and updating user subscription tiers.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Hooks for fetching, creating, updating, deleting the current user's profile and checking admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Authentication context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscription.ts: Hook for upgrading a user to Pro and refreshing profile data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables defining theme colors and global behaviors.
frontend/src/lib/dynamicLoad.ts: Utility to compute dynamic exercise loads based on bodyweight, experience, and config constraints.
frontend/src/lib/exercises.ts: Defines the Exercise interface and provides a mock list of weighted-vest and HYROX-style exercises with difficulty, multipliers, and guidance cues.
frontend/src/lib/gravityAI/knowledge.ts: Implements AI response generators for load recommendations, plan creation, recovery, technique, and product education using user profile data.
frontend/src/lib/gravityAI/respond.ts: Routes user messages to specific AI response functions based on keyword detection and returns structured replies.
frontend/src/lib/loadAlgorithms.ts: Provides experience-based load percentage logic and calculates recommended vest load ranges with optional warnings.
frontend/src/lib/loadZones.ts: Determines load safety zones and returns corresponding status text and color codes.
frontend/src/lib/workoutMetrics.ts: Calculates session volume and an intensity score based on load, sets, reps, and bodyweight.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx: Admin interface for viewing users and updating their subscription tiers with navigation and UI components.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays user performance metrics and a progress overview using mock data with refresh support.
frontend/src/pages/ExerciseDetailPage.ts: Displays a detailed view of an exercise with tags, media placeholders, and optional load recommendations based on the user profile.
frontend/src/pages/ExercisesPage.tsx: Shows a filterable grid of exercises and supports pull‑to‑refresh and navigation to exercise detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/GravityAIPage.tsx: Implements a chat UI for GravityAI with message history, suggestions, and AI responses gated behind Pro access.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login and redirects authenticated users to onboarding or the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/OnboardingPage.tsx: Guides new authenticated users through multi‑step profile creation and submits their athlete data.
frontend/src/pages/PlanDetailPage.tsx: Shows details of a selected training plan with weekly breakdowns and an RPE feedback section.
frontend/src/pages/PlansPage.tsx: Lists training plans with access gated by subscription tier and supports navigation to plan details.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile settings screen allowing users to view and edit profile fields, update or delete their account, and manage subscription info.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: UI flow for selecting a Pro subscription tier, applying discount codes, and upgrading the user's plan.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutBuilderPage.ts: Custom workout builder enabling users to add exercises, edit parameters, view volume and intensity metrics, and save templates.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theming, colors, typography, container behavior, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Metadata describing the project state, architecture, known issues, and feature requirements for the EVRVEST app.
